Inkwell uses code adapted from pdfcraft (read-only clone at commit b8ddf71), licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0
(LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE and pdfcraft's NOTICE sit next to this file).

Adapted files carry a header naming the pdfcraft path:
- src-tauri/src/convert/docx.rs   <- crates/export/src/lib.rs, crates/export/src/zip.rs   (Word writer)
- src-tauri/src/convert/create.rs <- crates/create/src/lib.rs   (text decoding and wrapping rules, TIFF page handling)
- src-tauri/src/forms/af.rs       <- crates/forms/src/af.rs       (AcroForm JavaScript subset: format, keystroke, validate, calculate)
- src-tauri/src/forms/detect.rs   <- crates/forms/src/detect.rs   (field auto-detection on flat forms)
- src-tauri/src/forms/mod.rs      <- crates/forms/src/appearance.rs (parse_da: default appearance string, font size clamp)
- src-tauri/src/textedit/content.rs   <- crates/content/src/lib.rs   (content stream parser, splice, matrices)
- src-tauri/src/textedit/font.rs      <- crates/fonts/src/pdf.rs     (font metrics, ToUnicode, encode)
- src-tauri/src/textedit/encodings.rs <- crates/fonts/src/encodings.rs (single-byte encodings, glyph names)
- src-tauri/src/textedit/text.rs      <- crates/edit/src/text.rs     (text lines, blocks, block rewrite)
- src-tauri/src/a11y/mod.rs       <- crates/a11y/src/lib.rs, crates/a11y/src/content.rs   (rule set, font Unicode mapping)
- src-tauri/src/a11y/tree.rs      <- crates/a11y/src/structure.rs   (structure tree reader)
- src-tauri/src/preflight/mod.rs    <- crates/preflight/src/lib.rs   (profiles, rule table, report shape)
- src-tauri/src/preflight/check.rs  <- crates/preflight/src/lib.rs   (PDF/A, PDF/X rule checks)
- src-tauri/src/preflight/fix.rs    <- crates/preflight/src/lib.rs   (conversion fixups)
- src-tauri/src/preflight/report.rs <- crates/preflight/src/lib.rs   (report text)
- src-tauri/src/preflight/xmp.rs    <- crates/preflight/src/xmp.rs   (XMP properties, pdfaid)
- src-tauri/src/preflight/icc.rs    <- crates/preflight/src/icc.rs   (built-in sRGB profile)
